summary: Frontend-only validation of GalleryManager per-day isolation + optimistic updates + trip switching on /admin → Galerías tab. Used trip tourMarrakechErg67 (6n/7d) which has DUPLICATE day.ids (day.2 & day.3 both share dia-2; day.4 & day.6 share dia-4; day.5 & day.7 share dia-5) — the worst-case scenario for the previous bug. action_items: MINOR: Close the ImageLibraryPicker modal automatically after a successful pick (image-library-pick-*). It currently stays open and overlays the gallery, blocking further hover-driven actions until the user clicks Cancelar.
critical_code_review_comments: GalleryManager.jsx onUpload (line 271-293) only updates `latest` from the server response and never combines with the seed images — works correctly because the backend appends server-side. Good. However, the very first upload on a day whose state is purely SEEDED (no persisted gallery yet) will result in the server creating a fresh doc with ONLY the uploaded image (since the seed images were never PUT to the server). On this run all observed days already had persisted data so no regression manifested, but this could surprise users on a brand-new day: the on-screen seed thumbnail vanishes after the first upload. Consider PUT-persisting the seed before the first upload, or seeding the server doc on first GET.

Index-based key apiKey(ns, index, dayId)=`${ns}.day.${index}.${dayId}` (line 53) successfully decorrelates duplicate day.ids — verified with tourMarrakechErg67 where 3 different day.ids appear twice each. Public consumer (DayImageGallery via dayGallerySegment) uses identical logic, so admin↔public alignment is preserved.

DayGalleryEditor uses local `images` state + `imagesRef.current` for picker callbacks (line 238-239,266-268). Good closure-safe pattern; avoids stale-state bugs that previously caused cross-day overwrites.
ImageLibraryPicker should call onClose() (or whatever prop dismisses it) inside the pick handler to provide one-click UX; currently the picker only closes via Cancelar.
GalleryManager.jsx is 417 lines — borderline OK but split-candidate if more features land (consider extracting DayGalleryEditor into its own file).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-day INDEX-based gallery keying is now verified for the previously-failing duplicate-day-id case (tourMarrakechErg67 — 3 duplicate ids: dia-2, dia-4, dia-5). Upload, library-pick, delete, setmain/reorder all isolate correctly and update optimistically with no page refresh. Trip switching reloads per-trip state immediately and keeps state independent per trip. Only outstanding cosmetic issue: ImageLibraryPicker modal stays open after a pick, blocking other interactions until 'Cancelar' is clicked.
rca of the issue: Original bug RCA confirmed and fixed: previous key `${ns}.day.${dayId}` collided when two days in a programme shared the same day.id, causing shared storage + duplicate React keys. Fix applied: `${ns}.day.${index}.${dayId}` where index is 1-based position, mirrored on admin (GalleryManager apiKey) and public (DayImageGallery via dayGallerySegment). Verified end-to-end: writing to Day 2 (dia-2) no longer leaks into Day 3 (also dia-2); Day 5 (dia-5) does not leak into Day 7 (also dia-5).
